notes: Adds native Reports for collection, firearms, ammunition reserve, accessories, maintenance/range activity and insurance/value reporting with print/PDF-friendly output and CSV exports.
Adds Media Library derivative repair with original-image fallback, missing/corrupt derivative detection, rebuild progress/results and original/optimized/total storage accounting.
Retires normal legacy UI handoffs: Reports is native, frontend legacy links are removed and the /legacy route and legacy.html asset are removed.
Reports honor the active Viewing scope for firearm inventory and respect the serial-number privacy setting.
